cards.answer: Talon is an AD-focused assassin who deals physical damage. He combines ability hits with a basic attack to trigger a bleed, using terrain vaults and invisibility to approach. Avoid extended close trades and watch for approaches across terrain.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended close trades and watch for approaches across terrain.

cards.answer: Blade's End: Ability hits apply Wound stacks. At three stacks, Talon's next basic attack consumes them to cause a physical damage bleed. Both passes of Rake and Shadow Assault apply Wound.
cards.counterplay: Back away as Wound builds and avoid letting him follow up with a basic attack.

His next basic attack against an enemy with maximum stacks consumes them all to deal physical damage over a short time.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing the stack setup helps avoid his central damage payoff.

cards.answer: Noxian Diplomacy: Talon leaps to a target and deals physical damage; a close-range cast critically strikes. Killing the target heals Talon and reduces this ability's cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Respect his targeted gap closer and avoid lingering in close range.

citations.quote: Active: Talon leaps to the target enemy, dealing physical damage. If the target is within melee range, Talon will critically strike the target.

cards.answer: Rake: Talon throws daggers that deal physical damage outward and again as they return to him. The returning daggers deal more damage and slow enemies hit.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the return path and account for Talon's position as the daggers come back.

citations.quote: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy.

facts.claim: Talon throws daggers that deal physical damage outward and again as they return to him.

citations.quote: The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

facts.claim: The returning daggers deal more damage and slow enemies hit.

cards.priority_reason: Avoiding the return hit reduces damage, slow pressure, and passive setup.

cards.answer: Assassin's Path: Talon vaults over terrain, including player-generated terrain. The ability has a short cooldown, but the same area of terrain remains unavailable to him for much longer.
cards.counterplay: Watch routes across nearby terrain and be cautious when chasing him through walls.

cards.answer: Shadow Assault: Talon spreads blades that deal physical damage, gains invisibility and movement speed, then converges the blades for more physical damage. The blades normally return to Talon; breaking stealth with a basic attack or Noxian Diplomacy sends them toward that target instead.
cards.counterplay: Create distance during his stealth and avoid the converging blades.
